Move your phone in a figure-eight motion until the accuracy improves.
The faint part of the shaft above the fill is how far the altitude may be off: it lies somewhere along the shaft between the fill\'s top and the faint part\'s.
Heading: the angle from magnetic north, clockwise.
Altitude: meters above sea level (m a.s.l.), from GPS.

On the arrow, the shaft fills from its tail up to the altitude, and the ticks split the scale into fifths. The scale grows with the altitude: the longer the head, the larger the scale, and the fill takes its color:
Allow location to see the altitude
The compass shows the altitude above sea level from GPS. It needs precise location for that, used only while the compass or its widget is on.
Above sea level from GPS, next to the heading and on the arrow
